title: 土石壩反濾層設計~Filter-zone design for embankment dams
focus: 串連留土透水施工與連續性的反濾層設計~Connecting retention permeability placement and continuity in filter design
summary: 本課以串連留土透水施工與連續性的反濾層設計為主線，先用留土粒徑與土類與透水能力與相容界定水力與構造條件，再將堆置分離與取樣、排水截面與水頭連結到變形相容與連續性。粒徑與水力算例只作篩選；反濾準則取決於被保護土分類、分散性與試驗程序。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops connecting retention permeability placement and continuity in filter design through Retention gradation and soil class and Permeability and compatibility, then connects Stockpile segregation and sampling and Drain area and hydraulic head to Deformation compatibility and continuity. Gradation and hydraulic examples are screening tools; filter criteria depend on base-soil classification dispersivity and test procedures. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的串連留土透水施工與連續性的反濾層設計，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。粒徑與水力算例只作篩選；反濾準則取決於被保護土分類、分散性與試驗程序。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on connecting retention permeability placement and continuity in filter design reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Gradation and hydraulic examples are screening tools; filter criteria depend on base-soil classification dispersivity and test procedures. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查留土粒徑與土類：Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless；再獨立檢查透水能力與相容：D15filter=0.60 mm; d15base=0.030 mm; permeabilityScreenRatio=0.60/0.030=20 dimensionless。敏感度：示意D15由0.60增至0.90mm時，對d85=0.20mm的比值由3增至4.5；這只顯示留土幾何改變，不能不分土類就以同一固定比值批准材料。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。粒徑與水力算例只作篩選；反濾準則取決於被保護土分類、分散性與試驗程序。 將封閉前拍攝管底與兩側反濾接續並核對實測包絡尺寸作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Retention gradation and soil class: Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless. Independently examine Permeability and compatibility: D15filter=0.60 mm; d15base=0.030 mm; permeabilityScreenRatio=0.60/0.030=20 dimensionless. Sensitivity: raising illustrative D15 from0.60 to0.90mm changes the ratio to a0.20mm base d85 from3 to4.5; this illustrates retention geometry and does not authorize a universal acceptance ratio for every soil. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Gradation and hydraulic examples are screening tools; filter criteria depend on base-soil classification dispersivity and test procedures. Use the following independent check: Photograph filter continuity below and beside the conduit before closure and survey its envelope. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 留土粒徑與土類~Retention gradation and soil class
units.title: 留土粒徑與土類~Retention gradation and soil class
units.mechanism: 反濾顆粒形成的孔隙須阻止被保護土持續遷移，又要讓局部細粒重新排列而不堵死。粒徑比只是土類相關準則的一環，細粒含量與分散性會改變判斷；不可把適用清潔砂的比值直接用在分散黏土，還需考慮基土代表性及侵蝕試驗。 驗證時應核對基土分組後的級配包絡並以指定反濾試驗檢驗持續侵蝕，並辨識以下失效情境：用平均級配代替最細基土會漏掉局部留土不足。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Filter pores must prevent continuing migration of the protected soil while allowing limited particle rearrangement without sealing the drainage path. A grain-size ratio is only part of soil-specific criteria; fines and dispersivity change the interpretation. A criterion for clean sand cannot automatically be transferred to dispersive clay without representative sampling and erosion testing. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Classify the base soil, compare gradation envelopes and test continuing erosion with the specified filter procedure. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using average gradation instead of the finer base soil overlooks local retention weakness. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.
units.verify: 核對基土分組後的級配包絡並以指定反濾試驗檢驗持續侵蝕。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「用平均級配代替最細基土會漏掉局部留土不足」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。~Classify the base soil, compare gradation envelopes and test continuing erosion with the specified filter procedure. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using average gradation instead of the finer base soil overlooks local retention weakness. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 用平均級配代替最細基土會漏掉局部留土不足。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對基土分組後的級配包絡並以指定反濾試驗檢驗持續侵蝕，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~Using average gradation instead of the finer base soil overlooks local retention weakness. Diagnose it by the following check: Classify the base soil, compare gradation envelopes and test continuing erosion with the specified filter procedure. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.
units.misconception: 單一粒徑比可以批准所有不同土類反濾~One grain-size ratio can approve filters for every soil class
units.practice: 交接時以核對基土分組後的級配包絡並以指定反濾試驗檢驗持續侵蝕作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對用平均級配代替最細基土會漏掉局部留土不足，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Classify the base soil, compare gradation envelopes and test continuing erosion with the specified filter procedure. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using average gradation instead of the finer base soil overlooks local retention weakness. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 透水能力與相容~Permeability and compatibility
units.title: 透水能力與相容~Permeability and compatibility
units.mechanism: 反濾不只留住土，也須在預期滲流量下維持低水頭；粒徑較粗通常有較高導水能力，但不能犧牲留土與內部穩定性。以小粒徑比比較僅能作初步幾何指標，壓實密度、細粒堵塞與顆粒形狀對實際導水率仍需試驗量化。 驗證時應對設計密度下試體做定水頭或變水頭試驗並量測排水坡降，並辨識以下失效情境：細粒污染降低導水率後上游孔壓可能持續累積。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A filter must maintain acceptable head while retaining soil. Coarser grains often improve drainage but may compromise retention or internal stability. A small-grain ratio is only a geometric screening indicator; compaction, pore clogging and grain shape influence actual conductivity and require hydraulic testing under representative placement conditions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Test conductivity at design density and measure the gradient needed for drainage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Fines contamination reduces conductivity and can allow upstream pore pressure to accumulate. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：D15filter=0.60 mm; d15base=0.030 mm; permeabilityScreenRatio=0.60/0.030=20 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: D15filter=0.60 mm; d15base=0.030 mm; permeabilityScreenRatio=0.60/0.030=20 dimensionless. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Fines contamination reduces conductivity and can allow upstream pore pressure to accumulate. units.anchor: 級配缺口與內穩~Gradation gaps and internal stability
units.title: 級配缺口與內穩~Gradation gaps and internal stability
units.mechanism: 級配寬廣不代表顆粒骨架能約束所有細料，缺級配材料可能讓細粒穿過粗粒孔隙形成潛蝕。應區分基土到反濾界面的留土與反濾自身的內部穩定；比較粒徑區段質量增量能提示缺口，仍需依適用方法與試驗確認。 驗證時應用密集篩孔資料重繪級配增量並檢驗滲流後流出顆粒組成，並辨識以下失效情境：只檢查界面粒徑比會漏掉反濾層自身的細粒流失。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A broad gradation does not guarantee that the coarse skeleton restrains its own fines. Gap-graded material can lose smaller particles through larger pores. Distinguish interface retention from stability within the filter itself; incremental mass in size bands can flag a gap, but interpretation requires an applicable assessment method and testing. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Replot gradation increments using closely spaced sieves and analyze particles discharged after seepage testing. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Checking only interface ratios misses fine-particle loss within the filter itself. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 鋪築厚度與偏差~Placed thickness and tolerances
units.title: 鋪築厚度與偏差~Placed thickness and tolerances
units.mechanism: 反濾帶的施工厚度須容納放樣、整平與相鄰土區交界的誤差，圖上厚度不等於每個剖面的連續有效厚度。保守幾何扣減可顯示容許誤差如何侵蝕施工餘量；實際評估仍需三維界面成果及接縫、轉角與穿越構造的細部。 驗證時應逐層量測兩側界面並在轉折與穿管位置增加橫斷面紀錄，並辨識以下失效情境：兩側土區同時侵入會使實際反濾帶局部中斷。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Placed thickness must accommodate survey, grading and adjacent-zone interface errors. The drawing thickness is not the continuous effective thickness at every section. A conservative geometric deduction illustrates how tolerances consume margin; assessment still needs three-dimensional interface records at transitions, corners and penetrations where continuity is vulnerable. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey both interfaces each lift and add cross-sections at bends and pipe penetrations. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Encroachment from both adjacent zones can locally interrupt the filter band. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 堆置分離與取樣~Stockpile segregation and sampling
units.title: 堆置分離與取樣~Stockpile segregation and sampling
units.mechanism: 卸料時粗粒容易滾至堆腳而細粒集中堆頂，使單一料堆產生不同級配。取樣應覆蓋生產、運輸、鋪築後的位置，不能只取易到達的表面。加權平均可以示範批次質量，卻不能掩蓋局部過粗或過細層造成的流路弱點。 驗證時應比較堆頂堆腳與鋪築後的分區篩分析而非只報混合平均，並辨識以下失效情境：平均級配合格仍可能存在連續過粗條帶。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~During dumping, coarse particles roll toward the toe while fines remain higher in the pile. Sampling must cover production, transport and placed material rather than an accessible surface alone. A weighted mean describes batch mass balance but cannot conceal local coarse or fine seams that create hydraulic weaknesses. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare sieve analyses from crest, toe and placed zones rather than only a blended average. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An acceptable mean gradation can coexist with a continuous overly coarse strip. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Two sublots: 60 t at8 percent fines and40 t at2 percent; massWeightedFines=(60*8+40*2)/100=5.6 percent。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Two sublots: 60 t at8 percent fines and40 t at2 percent; massWeightedFines=(60*8+40*2)/100=5.6 percent. units.anchor: 排水截面與水頭~Drain area and hydraulic head
units.title: 排水截面與水頭~Drain area and hydraulic head
units.mechanism: 排水帶應將反濾截獲的水導向可觀測出口，否則留土成功仍可能伴隨不利孔壓。達西估算把導水率、通水面積與長度連到所需水頭差；邊界受堵、局部不飽和或集中流會偏離簡化模型，因此不能以名義尺寸宣稱排水餘裕。 驗證時應以出口流量與沿排水帶孔壓驗證水頭分布並檢查堵塞位置，並辨識以下失效情境：出口堵塞會把原本排水邊界轉成蓄水邊界。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A drainage zone must carry intercepted water toward an observable outlet; successful retention alone does not prevent adverse pore pressure. Blocked boundaries, partial saturation or concentrated flow can invalidate the simple representation, so nominal geometry does not establish drainage reserve. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare outlet discharge and piezometric heads along the drain and inspect possible blockages. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A blocked outlet changes a drainage boundary into a water-storage boundary. units.anchor: 穿越構造與反濾環~Penetrations and filter diaphragms

units.anchor: 裂縫流量與留土試驗~Crack discharge and retention testing
units.title: 裂縫流量與留土試驗~Crack discharge and retention testing
units.mechanism: 反濾應能在基土裂縫供水下阻止持續侵蝕，但裂縫幾何與壓力集中不能由均質達西模型代表。矩形水槽式流量只是給定平均速度的連續方程，不預測裂縫速度；試驗需觀察侵蝕是否停止及流量是否穩定，而非只看最初清水外觀。 驗證時應在指定試驗壓差下同步量測出流與流失乾土質量直到趨勢可判讀，並辨識以下失效情境：只在低壓差做短時試驗可能漏掉後續持續侵蝕。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Filters must arrest continuing erosion when a base-soil crack supplies water, a concentrated condition poorly represented by uniform Darcy flow.
